units.source_text: 忽然，男人的身体僵硬了。

en.t: Suddenly, the man's body went rigid.

units.source_text: 他视线模糊，对不准焦点，还呼吸困难，不停地抽搐起来。

en.t: His vision blurred, he could not focus his eyes, and he began to breathe with difficulty and twitch uncontrollably.

units.source_text: 他猛然醒悟到自己的盘问其实毫无意义。

en.t: All at once he realized that his questioning had in fact been utterly meaningless.
Yes, of course, it was a rope ladder...

units.source_text: 绳梯，自己的力量是竖不起来的……

en.t: A rope ladder could not be set upright by his own strength...

units.source_text: 即使把绳梯弄到手，从下面也是无法挂上去的。

en.t: Even if he got hold of the rope ladder, there was no way to hang it up from below.

units.source_text: 这么说来，难道撤走绳梯的不是女人，而是别的什么人，从道路的上面把绳梯给拆走的吧……

en.t: In that case, perhaps it was not the woman who had removed the rope ladder, but someone else who had taken it away from up on the road...

units.source_text: 被沙子弄脏的邋遢胡子，迅速开始寒伧显眼起来。

en.t: His unkempt beard, dirtied with sand, quickly began to stand out in all its shabbiness.
